notes: REGISTERED on 2026-08-20, on inbound #764, and deliberately not before: the consumer's own adoption PR (BWJ-ecommerce/xoxowildhearts#1) merged 2026-08-19 21:33Z, and this register records what a consumer HAS -- claiming a lens early makes check-connectors report 'registered extension(s) missing' and turns the register into a false alarm. THE WORKFLOW SLOT IS DELIBERATELY NOT REGISTERED YET, and that is the one field this manifest could not answer without going stale within the day. Their merged main enables workflow-davekjohn; their in-flight branch feat-harness-hardening (ad315a1, 2026-08-20 00:16) switches it to workflow-default, which is the deliberate 'we have not chosen a workflow' slot and imposes nothing. Write the block once that branch has merged, exactly as the lens rule above was applied to the manifest as a whole. THE SECOND SHOPIFY CONSUMER, which is the reason this manifest was asked for rather than merely being owed: the register is where the two diverging can be seen. Three differences, all verified here. It has no CHANGELOG.md at all -- its history is a flat update_log.txt with date headers and no '##' sections. It has not adopted workflow-davekjohn/ (see the slot above). And its lint gate is pinned at --fail-level crash rather than error, which is arithmetic rather than laxity: theme-check reports 1504 pre-existing offences across 171 files (1078 errors, 426 warnings), so a gate at 'error' would be red on arrival and block every PR, while 'crash' still catches theme-check being unable to parse the theme at all.
